'''Hazefyre Claw''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A Landbreaker combatant corrupted by hazefyre. Absorbing hazefyre should not be regarded as a fortunate blessing. These raiders have become horribly twisted versions of their former selves.}}

==Overview==
[[Bonekrusher Raider]]s that got completely corrupted by hazefyre, Hazefyre Claws are slightly more threatening than their counterpart; They either attempt to claw three consecutive times, dealing Æther damage, or fires a shot from their hands. dealing Æther damage.
